name: Palette Swap
source:
"Would you trade your entire existence to play God in an artificial world? For almost my entire life, I thought that, given the opportunity, I wouldn't hesitate. But now...hell, what I wouldn't give to be home."

Zaria, an aspiring art student, discovers a mysterious painting in her school's art gallery. She gets sucked into the painting – which isn't all that bad, except her physical body is still in the real world, and whatever was previously in the painting is now in control of it. Zaria has a difficult decision: to either find some way to return home...or embrace this chance to start over, to succumb to the alluring charm of Elodia and see what she could make of it.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=38096]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2016.
translation:
「你願意用自己的全部存在，換取在人工世界裡扮演上帝的機會嗎？我幾乎一生都認為，如果有這樣的機會，我一定會毫不猶豫。但現在……該死，我真想付出一切回到家裡。」

憧憬成為藝術學生的扎莉婭，在學校畫廊裡發現了一幅神秘畫作。她被吸進了畫中——這本身並不算太糟，除了她的肉身仍在現實世界，而原本住在畫裡的存在已經控制了她的肉身。扎莉婭面臨艱難選擇：想辦法回家，或擁抱這個重新開始的機會，屈服於埃洛迪婭迷人的魅力，看看自己能把這裡變成什麼樣。

[來源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=38096]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]]

為NaNoRenO 2016製作。
